alex: Heads-up — rc5 cutover in ~50m (12:30 PT). PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 needs 2x LGTM to merge. It's a small kv-cache hotfix + smoke test. @samira @jordan can one of you take a second eye? lindsey/ben on standby for rotation.
samira: Taking first pass now. quick note: changed kv warmup timeout 30s -> 20s, leaving a comment on the flaky smoke test.
jordan: I'll give +1 after CI finishes. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: Merge gate status: awaiting 2 approvals + green CI. Queue position: 3. Use `/deploy status` for details.
lindsey: If samira signs off I can be backup approver — I'm on call but can do a quick scan.
ben: Kicking off local smoke and the integration repro. If green I'll drop LGTM.
alex: Thanks. If anyone gets blocked by intermittent CI flakes ping me and I can re-run. Reminder: need 2 approvals before 12:30 PT or we'll hold the hotfix for the next window.
samira: Left a tiny nit about the doc string; it's non-blocking. If Jordan resolves I'll approve.
jordan: CI is green and I resolved the nit. @ben @lindsey could you push approvals when you have a sec?
ben: local smoke passed, no regressions. LGTM :+1:
lindsey: skimming diffs now — looks fine, doc nit fixed. LGTM.
